text:
anya: Heads-up — partner ETL traffic spikes around 00:00 UTC are hitting per-key caps. Can we design a lightweight, auditable temporary-exemption flow for known partner/internal service keys? Need scheduled grace windows, auto-expiry, and telemetry.

matt: +1. Two constraints: prevent abuse & keep cost predictable. Timeboxed exemptions with explicit approver + billing tag. Also want automatic fallback to cheaper model variants during surge (e.g., `rv1` -> `rv1-quant`).

kevin: For abuse surface we can require the service account to be in the `partners` org and only allow creation from the Console + 2FA admin. Also limit TPS in the policy itself. What TPS numbers are we targeting at midnight?

sylvia: Partner ETL peaks ~120 TPS sustained for a 2–3m burst inside a 10m window. Typical pattern: short, high bursts. Proposed simple policy: `burst_window: 300s`, `burst_capacity: 300` (so short bursts allowed but guarded).

matt: Can we express the policy as a per-key object in the key-service DB and expose it in the Console? Example YAML sketch below: 

```
key_policies:
  - key: svc-partner-42
    allowed_windows:
      - start: "00:00"
        end: "00:10"
    burst:
      capacity: 300
      window_seconds: 300
    fallback_model: "redwood/rv1-quant"
    expires_at: "2024-06-30T00:10:00Z"
    approved_by: "eng-platform-admin"
```

ops-bot: policy-created: policy-789 for key svc-partner-42 by sylvia (:white_check_mark:)

kevin: Telemetry needs: `per_key_burst_credits_used`, `per_key_override_active`, `per_key_override_duration_seconds`. Console should have a per-key card showing active override, expiry, approver, and cost delta.

anya: UX ask: rollout wizard in Console — select key(s), pick window, pick fallback model, set auto-expiry, require approver. Show estimated cost delta before applying. Also show audit link and the raw policy JSON.

billing-bot: cost-preview: approx +$0.23 per 100k tokens for rv1 (non-quant) -> quant reduces to +$0.05 (simulated) :money_with_wings:

matt: Good. Operational rules: 1) limit creation to `eng-platform-admin` or assigned approvers, 2) automatic expiry enforced by policy engine, 3) canary to partner-test orgs first.

sylvia: I'll open a PR with the policy schema change and a small migration to add `approved_by` and `expires_at` fields. Will also add unit tests to block forever policies without an approver.

anya: Next actions: sylvia PR for schema, kevin add telemetry metrics + dashboard card, matt add RBAC gating for creation, ops to add audit hook for policy mutations. Also add alert: `override_active > 24h` -> notify oncall. Ping @kevin for telemetry work. :thumbsup:
